question: What social inclusiveness and material abundance define the settlement in this description?
premises: It is joined with all castes.
It is endowed with all goods.
Social and material completeness are both asserted.
inference: The settlement is characterized by inclusion of all castes and possession of all kinds of goods.
uncertainties: The referent continues from prior verses and is not explicitly restated.
plain_english: It is joined with all castes and endowed with all kinds of goods.
